rules.interpretation_hi_en: Saturn bahut zyada ubhra — solitude isolation ban sakti hai aur seriousness bojh. Balance ke liye hafte mein kam se kam do baar logon ke beech jao, aur ek 'halka' shauk rakho — music, khel, comedy, kuch bhi jo hansaye. Gehraai rakho, par surface par saans lene bhi aao.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — exaggerated Mount denotes exaggeration of all Saturn qualities — softened per safety policy (melancholy framing reframed to balance advice)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Born 21 Dec–20 Jan (Saturn Positive) aur Saturn ubhra — lohe ki will power aur independent soch. Kisi ka bandhan bardasht nahi. Yeh aapko bada banata hai, bas 'akele hi sab kar lunga' wale trap se bacho — delegate karna bhi strength hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — Saturn Positive 21 Dec–20 Jan (+7 days fading): strong will force and mentality; independence of thought and action; detest restraint

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap aksar akela mehsoos karte ho, aur jab koi care de bhi toh yakeen nahi hota. Zimmedaariyon ka bojh zyada mehsoos hota hai, phir aap apne shell mein chale jaate ho. Ek cheez yaad rakho: jo log saath hain, unhe andar aane do — madad lena kamzori nahi hai. Ek insaan chuno jisse aap hafte mein ek baar sach bolte ho.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — feel lonely and isolated; scarcely believe affection offered; feel responsibilities too heavily and retire into their shell — softened per safety policy (gloom framing reframed)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Dikhaave se door, aap andar se gehre devotional ho — chahe mandir jaate ho ya nahi. Bina reward ya pehchaan ki umeed ke logon ka bhala karte ho, khaaskar bade level par. Yeh quiet greatness hai. Bas kabhi-kabhi apni mehnat ka credit lena bhi seekho — woh bhi sewa hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — deeply devotional nature even when not outwardly religious; do good for the masses without expecting recognition or reward

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Dharm, mysticism, occult — yeh aapko bahut khinchte hain, par aap extreme par chale jaate ho, aur apne views mein doosron ki dakhal bardasht nahi karte. Ek practice: jis cheez par sabse pakka yakeen hai, usi par mahine mein ek baar imaandaari se doubt karke dekho. Mazboot aastha sawaalon se darti nahi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — religion, mysticism, occultism appeal strongly but taken to extremes; cannot brook interference in views — softened per safety policy (fanaticism reframed)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap deep thinker ho aur buddhimaan logon ki dil se kadar karte ho. Cheiro kehta hai aise log aksar bhaari zimmedaari wali positions par milte hain — jahan akele kathin faisle lene padte hain: judge, surgeon, administrator, founder. Us seat ke liye khud ko taiyaar rakho, aur us bojh ko baantna bhi seekho.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — deep thinkers, admire intellectual people; often hold positions of great responsibility (destiny-instrument/violence passage excluded per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Cheiro Saturn ke logon ko pair, ghutne aur ankles ka khaas dhyan rakhne ko kehta hai. Practical: sahi joote, exercise se pehle warm-up, seedhiyon aur phisalne wali jagah par extra care, aur joint mobility ko daily routine banao. Chhoti saavdhaani, badi bachat.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — tendency to accidents to the feet, knees and limbs — softened per safety policy (named diseases excluded; protective nudge only)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Born 21 Jan–18 Feb (Saturn Negative) — Saturn ki energy aapke dimaag mein hai. Akelaapan vichaaron ka hai: lagta hai koi aapki soch ko sach mein samajhta nahi. Bahut sensitive ho, jaldi chot lagti hai. Apne jaise 2-3 deep log dhoondo — aapko bheed nahi, samajh chahiye.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — Saturn Negative/mental 21 Jan–18 Feb (+7 days): Saturn qualities felt mentally; lonely in ideas and thoughts; sensitive, easily wounded

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap logon ko ek nazar mein padh lete ho — itna saaf ki kabhi-kabhi yahi khushi kam kar deta hai. Dhokha aapke liye sabse bada aparaadh hai, aur jab lagta hai dhokha hua, aapka reaction logon ko chauka deta hai. Is skill ko hiring, negotiation aur partnerships mein lagao — wahan yeh sona hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — read character instinctively, 'see through' people too easily to be happy; bitterly resent being deceived

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Dost bane toh zindagi bhar ke — aap unke liye kuch bhi kar jaoge. Par dhokha mile toh maafi bahut mushkil hai aur grudge saalon chalta hai. Yeh energy saamne wale se zyada aapko jalati hai. 'Let go' ko ek skill ki tarah seekho — maaf karna unke liye nahi, apne liye hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — loyal true friends, any sacrifice for a friend; bitter when deceived — softened per safety policy (revenge framing reframed to forgiveness)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Samaaj ke liye time aur paisa dete ho — par apne tareeke se, apni shart par. Bheed, theatre, concerts, public meetings pasand hain, phir bhi sach bolo toh andar akelapan rehta hai. Public good mein ek steady, regular role lo — akelepan ka sabse accha ilaaj purpose hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — active for the public good, give time and money in their own way; keen interest in public meetings, theatres, concerts; yet feel alone

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki aankhon mein ek shaant control hai — ghabraaye hue, anxious, excitable logon ko aap settle kar dete ho, chahe khud andar se nervous ho. Counselling, healthcare, teaching, crisis management, HR — aise career aapko naturally milte hain. Yeh rare gift hai; iski training lo.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — quiet controlling power with the eyes; greatest control over excitable and nervous people; fated to meet such cases — softened per safety policy ('insane' wording removed)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Stress seedha pet par lagta hai, haath-pair thande rehte hain, aur aap shayad hi kabhi 'full strong' mehsoos karte ho — phir bhi jab duty ya usool daav par hon, aapka will power sabko hairaan kar deta hai. Us reserve tank ko roz bharo: warm khaana, regular neend, aur stress ko pet tak pahunchne se pehle bol dena.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.VIII — nerves of the stomach, poor circulation, cold hands and feet; seldom feel strong yet enormous power of resistance when will is called on — softened per safety policy (named conditions excluded)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Sun (Apollo) mount ubhra hua — Cheiro kehta hai yeh hamesha shubh hai. Chamakne ki ichha, public mein pehchaan, aur ek sunny, lucky, forceful personality. Spotlight aapke liye bana hai — usse sharmao mat, bas usse kisi meaningful kaam par focus karo.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — Mount of the Sun large: glory, publicity, desire to shine; 'always considered a good Mount to have large'; bright, sunny, forceful, happy, lucky personality

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Sundarta aapki zaroorat hai — ghar, kapde, workspace, sab mein taste dikhta hai; practical career mein bhi aap artistic surroundings bana lete ho. Generous aur thode luxurious ho. Budget mein ek 'beauty line' rakho, par luxury ko lifestyle inflation mat banne do.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — enthusiasm for the beautiful in all things; build beautiful houses, artistic surroundings; expansive, generous, luxurious tastes

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Sun mount flat — spotlight ki bhookh kam hai; aap background mein kaam karna pasand karte ho aur tareef se thoda asahaj ho. Yeh theek hai, par career mein visibility bhi currency hai. Mahine mein ek baar apna kaam kisi ko dikhao — LinkedIn post, demo, ya bas boss ko update.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — inferred inverse of the large-Sun reading (Cheiro gives no explicit flat reading in this chapter; derived from Ch.V quality list)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Born 21 July–20 Aug (House of the Sun) aur Sun mount ubhra — Cheiro aapko 'heart force of the human race' kehta hai: dil khol kar dene wale, sympathetic, aur itni strong personality ki kisi bhi halat mein bheed se alag dikhte ho. Yeh energy leadership ke liye bani hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — House of the Sun 21 Jul–20 Aug (generally until 28 Aug): 'heart force of the human race'; generous and sympathetic; strong personality stands out anywhere

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap brutally frank ho — sach se bhaagne walon ko aap bakshte nahi, chahe apna hi kyun na ho. Standards bahut high hain. Frankness rakho, par delivery mein narmi laao: log sach tab sunte hain jab woh sunne layak tareeke se kaha jaaye. Sach + sammaan = asar.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — no mercy for evaders of the truth; brutal frankness even towards own family — softened per safety policy (denounce-own-children passage reframed)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka pyaar bhi intense, nafrat bhi — beech ka raasta nahi. Dost par hamla ho, khaaskar peeth peeche, toh aap dhaal ban jaate ho. Intensity aapki khoobsurti hai; bas rishton mein thoda grey zone seekho — har insaan ya toh hero ya villain nahi hota.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — love intensely and hate intensely, no middle path; greatest loyalty if a friend is attacked, especially underhandedly

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap khud sachche ho, isliye maan lete ho ki doosre bhi hain — aur dhokha kha jaate ho. Cheiro warn karta hai ki baad ki umar mein yahi dhokhe mann par bhaari pad sakte hain. Bachaav abhi se: logon ko time aur chhote tests se parakho, paise aur partnership mein likhit agreements rakho, aur apni khushi ko sirf doosron ke behaviour par mat tikao. Aapki roshni aapki apni hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — truthful and honest but often terribly deceived; risk of later-life disillusionment — softened per safety policy (suicide/melancholy passage EXCLUDED; reframed as trust-vetting advice)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Pride aapka soft spot hai — madad maangne se behtar aap takleef sehna pasand karte ho, aur pride par chot bahut jaldi lagti hai. Jaldbaazi aur garam mizaaj public life mein dushman banate hain. Yaad rakho: help maangna kamzori nahi, strategy hai — bade log bhi maangte hain.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — extremely proud, will not ask favours; easily wounded through pride; impetuous and hot-tempered, make many enemies — softened per safety policy ('sooner die' phrasing removed)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Public life — stage, leadership, media, politics, performing arts, brand-building — aapke liye natural fit hai. Bas pehle se jaan lo ki wahan attacks bhi aate hain, kabhi-kabhi bahut unfair. Thick skin banana aapki training ka hissa hai, talent ka nahi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — usually well fitted for public life, though often bitterly attacked there

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Born 21 Jan–18 Feb (Sun Negative) — aap doosron ke liye fortune bana dete ho aur khud ke liye bahut kam rakhte ho. Manager, advisor, CFO, fund manager roles mein kamaal — par apni fees, equity aur savings pehle tay karo. Generosity ko structure do, warna woh self-neglect ban jaati hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — Sun Negative 21 Jan–18 Feb (+7 days): far more successful managing for others; excellent in business and finance but for others; make fortunes for others and keep a pittance

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap underdog ke saath khade hote ho, aur jo bhi takleef mein hai uske liye actively kaam karte ho. Iska price: taqatwar log aapko napasand karte hain. Yeh badge of honour hai — bas lambi ladai ke liye kuch powerful allies bhi banao.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — active in plans for the relief of distress and the public good; take the part of the 'under dog'; disliked by the richer and more powerful classes

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Government, public leadership, debate, manch — wahan aapki eloquence khilti hai aur aap logon ki awaaz ban jaate ho. Par Cheiro kehta hai aap 'role of the moment' nibhaate ho, phir shaant zindagi mein chale jaate ho. Isliye spotlight ke baad ka 'second act' pehle se plan karo — paisa, skill, aur ek shaant shauk.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — governmental positions, leaders of party or public opinion; eloquence in debate; love public ceremonies and gatherings; play the role of the moment then retire into private life — softened per safety policy (end-of-days prediction excluded)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap har mushkil jhel sakte ho — kyunki aapko andar se pata hota hai ki aapne apna farz nibhaaya. Yehi feeling aapko har loss, har attack, har disappointment se upar uthaati hai. Yeh aapka armour hai; isse roz ek accha kaam karke polish karo.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — can endure any martyrdom or suffering, sustained by the feeling of having done their duty — softened per safety policy (suicide comparison EXCLUDED)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Dhoop aur sookha mausam aapki sabse badi dawa hai — Cheiro ke shabdon mein 'greatest safeguard'. Thand aur seelan se door raho, roz 15-20 minute dhoop lo, haath-pair garm rakho, aur sports mein ghutne aur ankles ko protect karo.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IX — very dry climates and plenty of sunlight 'their greatest safeguard'; poor circulation and loss of natural heat; care of limbs, knees and ankles — softened per safety policy (named conditions excluded)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Venus mount accha ubhra hua (par bahut zyada nahi) — pyaar aur saath ki chaah, doosron ko khush karne ki ichha, aur har roop mein sundarta ki kadar. Artists, singers, musicians ke haath mein yeh mount hamesha dikhta hai. Aap warm, lovable insaan ho — yeh aapka sabse bada asset hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — Mount of Venus well-formed and not too large: desire for love and companionship, desire to please, worship of beauty; artistic emotional temperament; prominent in artists, singers, musicians

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Venus mount ke neeche haath ki badi khoon ki nali (palmar arch) hoti hai — Cheiro ke mutabik ubhra Venus = accha blood flow, strong circulation, robust health. Aapke paas natural stamina aur warmth hai; isse regular movement aur neend se maintain karo — yeh reserve khatam bhi ho sakta hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — Venus covers the 'Great Palmar Arch'; a large Mount indicates plentiful blood supply, strong active circulation, more robust health

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Venus bahut ubhra — physical warmth aur passion high hai; aap life ko indriyon se jeete ho: khaana, sparsh, music, pyaar. Yeh intensity khoobsurat hai — bas consent, boundaries aur commitment ke frame mein rakho. Bina frame ke yahi intensity rishton ko jalaati hai, frame ke saath unhe garm rakhti hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — large Mount shows greater passion and sensuality than when flat — softened per safety policy (intensity + boundaries framing)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Venus mount flat — aapka pyaar dimaag aur dil se hai, sharir se kam; physical drive aur energy reserve low rehta hai. Iska matlab thanda nahi — 'mental lover' hai, jo baaton aur samajh se judta hai. Stamina ke liye thoda conscious effort karo: walk, neend, protein, dhoop.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — Mount is Negative when small or flat; flat/flabby Venus linked to lower vitality and less physical passion; affection more mental

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Venus well-shaped + baaki haath normal = Cheiro ke shabdon mein 'excellent sign': natural magnetism aur attraction. Aapko try nahi karna padta — log khinche chale aate hain. Is charm ko rishte banane mein lagao, sirf impress karne mein nahi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — with the rest of the hand normal, a well-shaped Venus is 'an excellent sign': magnetism and attraction of one sex to the other

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Venus ek amplifier hai — haath mein jo bhi tendencies hain, yeh unhe tez karta hai. Agar baaki haath weak signals de raha hai (kamzor Head line, weak thumb, tooti lines), toh impulses ko brake dene wali aadatein pehle banao: routine, sleep, aur ek insaan jo aapko seedha bole.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — found with 'vicious or abnormal signs' elsewhere, Venus increases those tendencies — softened per safety policy (amplifier framing; no moral label)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Born 20 April–20 May (Venus Positive) aur Venus ubhra — aap mein ek curious dominating power hai; opinions pakke, zid pakki, jhukna mushkil. Strength hai, par 'unyielding' ko 'reliable' banao, 'haavi' nahi. Apni baat manwane ke liye taaqat nahi, warmth use karo — woh aapke paas zyada hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — Venus Positive 20 Apr–20 May (minor until 27 May): curious dominating power over others; dogmatic, unyielding, stiff-necked — softened per safety policy ('tyrannical' reframed)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Pyaar mein aap poori tarah samarpit ho jaate ho — jise chaaha uske liye koi bhi kurbani chhoti hai, chahe baahar ki duniya ke liye aap kitne bhi sakht ho. Yeh rare depth hai. Bas apni identity, dost aur self-respect ko bhi us list mein rakho — poora ghul jaana pyaar nahi, gayab ho jaana hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — when they love, they become devoted; no sacrifice too great for the one who holds their affection

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap zabardast host ho — khaane ka taste, mehmaan-nawazi, acche kapde, aur kam mein bhi 'rich look' create karna. Log aapko asal se zyada ameer samajhte hain. Hospitality aapka social superpower hai — network isi se banao; bas dikhaave ke liye udhaar mat lo.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — hospitable and generous; wonderful hosts with great taste in food; dress with taste; considered richer than they are, make a good show on little

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Pasand-napasand impulsive, zabaan seedhi, gussa tez — aur garam hone par yaad nahi rehta ki kya keh diya. Phir gehra pachtawa. Pattern wahi puraana: garam mein bolna band, thande mein baat karo. Aur jise chot pahunchai, usse jaldi sorry — aapke liye yeh aasaan hai kyunki dil saaf hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — impulsive in likes and dislikes; too frank and outspoken; quick temper with no restraint when roused; quickly over and most regretful

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap par surroundings ka asar bahut gehra hai — gloomy, uncongenial jagah mein aap andar se neeche ho jaate ho. Ghar aur workspace ko roshni, rang, paudhe aur saaf-safaai se curate karo; yeh aapke mood ka infrastructure hai, luxury nahi. Toxic mahaul se nikalna aapke liye self-care hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — most easily influenced by surroundings; become low in gloomy and uncongenial conditions — softened per safety policy ('morbid and depressed' reframed)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Cheiro Venus Positive logon ko jaldi shaadi se mana karta hai — pehla bada rishta aksar galti nikalta hai, aur independent nature galat match mein phans kar apne raaste dhoondh leti hai. Yeh bhavishyavani nahi, salah hai: commit karne se pehle waqt lo, aur 'pyaar' aur 'compatibility' dono check karo.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — should not marry early; first attempt usually a mistake; independent character leads to unconventional lives if mismatched — softened per safety policy (advice framing, not prediction)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jab affection jaag jaaye, jealousy bhi jaag jaati hai — khaaskar jab ghar ki shaanti ko koi chhede. Jealousy ko alarm samjho, hathiyaar nahi: usse 'baat karne' ka trigger banao, 'control karne' ka nahi. Partner ko insecurity batana, accusation se behtar hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII — inclined to be very jealous when affections are roused, especially if the peace of the home is disturbed

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Born 21 Sep–20 Oct (Venus Negative) — aapka pyaar utna hi intense hai, bas mental aur spiritual zyada, physical kam. Aapko soul companionship chahiye — dimaag se connect hone wala partner. Apni needs clearly bolo; sab log 'mental intimacy' ko pyaar nahi samajhte, aur aapko samjhaana padega.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII (neg.) — Venus Negative 21 Sep–20 Oct (minor until 27 Oct): Mount seldom prominent; affections as intense but mental rather than physical; spiritual love, crave soul companionship

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aap Venus Negative window mein born ho par Venus mount phir bhi saaf ubhra hua hai — Cheiro kehta hai yeh exception hai: mental pyaar ke saath physical warmth bhi poori tarah active hai. Best of both worlds — bas dono needs ko ek hi partner se expect karte waqt patient raho.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII (neg.) — exceptions can be seen by watching if the Mount of Venus is large with people born in this period

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki intuition tez hai — presentiments, sapne jo sach nikalte hain, gut feelings jo sahi hoti hain. Problem: aap unhe reasoning se kaat dete ho. Intuition ko data ki tarah treat karo — note karo, date lagao, track karo ki kitni baar sahi thi. Phir usse bharosa karna aasaan hoga.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII (neg.) — keen intuition and mental balance; presentiments, psychic experiences, dreams, clairvoyance, often spoiled by the reasoning faculties

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Pyaar mein aapka sabse bada dushman hesitation hai — aap sochte reh jaate ho, pros-cons tolte ho, aur mauka nikal jaata hai; bas regret bachta hai. Cheiro ki seedhi salah: pehle impression par act karo, jo mauka saamne hai usse lo. Perfect clarity kabhi nahi aayegi — 70% sure ho toh haan bolo.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII (neg.) — in love nearly always unhappy because they hesitate and reason while opportunity passes; advised to act on first impressions and intuition and take the opportunities Fate offers

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Law, medicine, judiciary, research — jahan har point ko imaandaari se tolna padta hai, wahan aap master ban sakte ho. Aapka motive paisa nahi, mastery aur insaaf hai — isliye specialist bano, generalist nahi. Aur haan, mastery ki sahi keemat lena bhi insaaf hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII (neg.) — study Law to improve it for others; great desire for knowledge, abstruse subjects, weigh every point conscientiously; excellent doctors, judges, lawyers as masters of a branch rather than for worldly gain

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapki physical reserve limited hai aur nerves jaldi thak jaati hain — low mood aur akelepan ki feeling aa sakti hai. Isko fight mat karo, manage karo: neend non-negotiable, roz halka movement, aur hafte mein kam se kam ek gehri baat-cheet kisi apne se. Agar mood lamba neeche rahe, toh doctor ya counsellor se baat karna samajhdaari hai, kamzori nahi.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.XII (neg.) — lack of physical strength, exhaustion of the nerves, low spirits, intense feeling of loneliness — softened per safety policy (named conditions and surgery prediction EXCLUDED; professional-help pointer added)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapke haath ke chaturbhuj (hriday aur mastishk rekha ke beech) mein La Croix Mystique — Rahasyamayi Cross — bana hai. Yeh adhyatm, gupt-vidya aur rahasya-gyaan ki naisargik pratibha ka chinh hai. Jyotish, dhyan, tantra-mantra, ya bas 'parde ke peeche kya hai' — is disha mein aapki ruchi janamjaat hai, seekhi hui nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.XIII — La Croix Mystique in the quadrangle (7, Plate XX): natural gift for mysticism and occultism

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Rahasyamayi Cross Guru parvat ki taraf jhuka hai — adhyatm mein aapki ruchi ke peeche thodi mahatvakanksha bhi hai: gyaan se milne wala samman aur pehchaan aapko utna hi kheenchta hai jitna gyaan khud. Isme burai nahi — bas jaante raho ki asli gehrai tab aati hai jab seekhna dikhaave se bada ho.

sources.loc: Ch.XIII — mark nearer Jupiter: studies employed for pride or ambition

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Rahasyamayi Cross chaturbhuj ke kendra mein hai (ya bhagya rekha par / Shani ke neeche) — adhyatm aapke liye shauk nahi, jeevan-dharm banega. Cheiro ke anusaar aise log is gyaan ko profession bana lete hain ya apni khoj ko kitabon ka roop dete hain. Aapki career ki dhaara mein guru, lekhak ya guide banne ka yog likha hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XIII — centre position / across Fate / under Saturn: occultism as religion, profession, books

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Rahasyamayi Cross Chandra parvat ki taraf neeche hai — aapka adhyatm shraddha aur bhaav se chalta hai, shastra se kam. Cheiro kehte hain aise log doosron ko gehra prabhavit karte hain, aur inke haathon se bhavishyavani ke sur wali sundar rahasyamayi kavita nikalti hai. Likhte ho toh mystic poetry try karo — woh aapki natural language hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XIII — lower position near Luna: devotional-superstitious approach, influence, prophetic mystic poetry

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Guru parvat par Ring of Solomon — Suleman ki Mudrika — bani hai. Yeh bhi rahasya-vidya ka chinh hai, par Guru ki shakti ke saath: aap sirf seekhne wale nahi, MASTER banne ke liye bane ho. Adhyatm, jyotish ya gyaan ke kshetra mein adhikar aur netritva ki bhookh — guru-material likha hai aapke haath mein.

sources.loc: Ch.XIII — Ring of Solomon (8, Plate XX): aims at mastery/adept-level power in mystic subjects

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapke nakhoon par ek gehri aadi lakeer (furrow) hai — parampara mein iska arth: kuch samay pehle sharir ya nervous system par ek asadharan strain aaya tha (bimari, bada stress). Nakhoon 9 mahine mein base se edge tak badhta hai, toh lakeer ki jagah us daur ki timeline batati hai: kinare ke paas = lagbhag 9 mahine pehle, beech mein = 4-5 mahine, base ke paas = pichhla mahina. Yeh guzre hue daur ka nishan hai — matlab body ne woh phase paar kar liya. Ab recovery ko poora hone do: neend, poshan, aur pace ka dhyan.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IV — nail furrow + 9-month growth clock; rendered as past-strain recovery framing per safety policy (see meta.nail_growth_clock)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapke nakhoonon par bahut saare safed dhabbe hain — parampara ise thake hue system ka sanket maanti hai: nervous energy low chal rahi hai. Practical matlab: yeh recharge ka signal hai — neend poori, khana dhang ka, aur schedule mein saans lene ki jagah. Koi diagnosis nahi — bas body ka ek gentle reminder.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.IV — many white flecks: nervous system in low state; softened to recharge framing per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Guru parvat par sitara (star) — Cheiro ke anusaar sabse bhagyashali chinhon mein se ek. Maan-samman, shakti aur pad mein vriddhi ka vaada. Netritva ke avsar aapki ore khinche chale aayenge.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Star on Mount of Jupiter (11, Plate XXII)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya parvat par sitara — dhan aur yash ka yog, aksar sarvajanik jeevan (public life) ke zariye. Naam aur naame dono saath aane ka sanket — spotlight se bhaago mat.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Star on Mount of Sun: riches and glory via public life

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Budh parvat par sitara — vyapar, commerce, vigyan ya vaani-kala (eloquence) mein asadharan safalta ka sanket. Deal close karne ki kala aapke haath mein likhi hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Star on Mount of Mercury (11, Plate XXII)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Guru ke neeche wale Mangal parvat par sitara — sahas ke kshetra mein vishisht pehchaan ka yog: ek nirnayak jeet ya bold move jo poore career ko naya naam de degi. Cheiro iski tulna Waterloo ki jeet se karte hain — aapka bhi ek defining moment likha hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Star on Mount of Mars under Jupiter: distinction via one decisive victory

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Budh ke neeche wale Mangal parvat par sitara — jeevan ki ladai dimaag se ladkar samman paane ka yog. Sangharsh se ghabrao mat; aapki mansik dridhta hi aapka hathiyaar hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Star on Mount of Mars under Mercury: honour won by mentality

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Chandra parvat par sitara — kalpana aur avishkar ki shakti se badi prasiddhi ka yog. Creator, writer, inventor, designer — aapki imagination hi aapka brand banegi.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Star on Mount of Moon: celebrity via imagination or inventive faculties

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Shukra parvat ke kendra par sitara — vyaktitva mein asadharan aakarshan (magnetism) ka sanket. Log aapki taraf sahaj khinche aate hain, aur prem ke maamlon mein aapka charm kaam karta hai. Is shakti ka istemal samajhdari se karna aapki zimmedari hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Star on centre of Mount of Venus: magnetism, success with opposite sex

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Guru parvat par cross — Cheiro ke anusaar cross ki EK MATRA shubh sthiti. Jeevan mein ek asadharan bhagyashali prem ya sneh-sambandh aane ka sanket. Jab woh vyakti aaye, pehchaan lena.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Cross on Mount of Jupiter: extraordinarily fortunate affection; only favourable cross position

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya parvat par cross — dhan ke maamle mein nirasha ka sanket: ummeed se kam returns, atki hui kamai. Financial planning conservative rakho, ek hi daav par sab mat lagao.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Cross on Mount of Sun: disappointment in riches

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Budh parvat par cross — len-den aur vyavhar mein imandari ka sawaal khada hota hai. Apne aas-paas ke sauda-baazon ki niyat parakh ke chalo, aur khud bhi shortcut ke lalach se door raho — chhoti bezimani badi keemat leti hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Cross on Mount of Mercury: dishonesty

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Budh ke neeche wale Mangal parvat par cross — raaste mein bada virodh (opposition) aane ka sanket. Log aapke plans ke aade aayenge. Dhairya aur documentation — dono saath rakho; virodh se ladna nahi, use outlast karna hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Cross on Mount of Mars under Mercury: great opposition

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Guru ke neeche wale Mangal parvat par cross — jhagdon aur takraav se haani ka yog. Krodh par sanyam aapke liye luxury nahi, zaroorat hai: garam behas se door raho, vivaad ko likhit aur thande dimaag se suljhao.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Cross on Mount of Mars under Jupiter; death clause excluded per safety policy, encoded as conflict-caution

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Chandra parvat par cross — kalpana ka aapko hi dhokha dene ka sanket: man mein bani kahani ko sach maan lena. Bade faisle feelings par nahi, facts par lo — decide karne se pehle ek baar data ya kisi bharosemand vyakti se cross-check zaroor karo.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Cross on Mount of Moon: self-deception via imagination; low-Luna drowning clause excluded per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Shukra parvat par cross — prem sambandhon mein ek bhaari, uljhane wala prabhav aane ka sanket: aisa rishta ya aakarshan jo kheenchta bahut hai par sukoon kam deta hai. Aise influence ko pehchaan kar boundaries banana hi bachav hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Cross on Mount of Venus: fatal influence of affections; softened per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Mastishk rekha ke theek upar cross — parampara mein sir ki suraksha ke prati saavdhani ka sanket. Practical roop mein: bike par helmet hamesha, adventure sports mein protection, laparwahi se bacho. Saavdhani hi is chinh ka jawab hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Cross above Line of Head: accident/injury to head; softened to protective-caution framing per safety policy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Hatheli par square (chaukor) — ise Raksha ka Chinh (Mark of Preservation) kaha jaata hai. Jis rekha par aur jis samay-bindu par yeh banta hai, us daur mein sankat aakar bhi tal jaane ka sanket. Aapke haath mein ek built-in raksha-kavach hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — The Square: Mark of Preservation, escape from dangers at that period (13, Plate XXII)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Jeevan rekha par square — kathin samay mein raksha-kavach ka sanket: sehat ya suraksha par bada sankat aaye bhi toh nikal jaane ka yog. Parampara ise sabse mazboot protective chinhon mein ginti hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Square on Line of Life (13, Plate XXII); wording softened per safety policy (no lifespan claims)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Bhagya rekha par square — nuksan se raksha ka sanket: career ya paise par aaya sankat poori tarah dooba nahi payega. Setback aayega toh bhi recovery likhi hai.

sources.loc: Ch.XVI — Square on Line of Fate: preservation from loss

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya rekha maujood hai — chumbakiya vyaktitva, logon par prabhav aur pehchan paane ki natural shakti. Yeh 'luck line' hai: jahan se yeh shuru hoti hai, wahan se zindagi mein roshni, samman aur avsar badhte jaate hain.

sources.loc: Ch.VI, Plate XV position 1, pp.61-62

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya rekha nahi dikhti — matlab talent ki kami nahi, limelight ki hai. Aapka kaam khud nahi bolega; aapko use bulwana padega. Visibility ko skill ki tarah treat karo — apna kaam dikhana seekhna hi aapka missing piece hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VI, pp.66 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya rekha bhagya rekha se uthti hai — jis umra par yeh uthti hai, wahan se aapke career ko pakki pehchan milti hai. Yeh luck nahi, kamai hui izzat hai — apni mehnat se banayi hui.

sources.loc: Ch.VI, Plate XV position 3, p.63

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya rekha Chandra parvat se uthti hai — public ki pasand se milne wali safalta. Creators, performers, speakers aur un sabka sanket jinki taraqqi audience tay karti hai. Chamak zabardast hogi, lekin public ka mood badalta hai — isliye income ke stable pillars bhi banao.

sources.loc: Ch.VI, Plate XV position 4, p.63

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya rekha mastishk rekha se uthti hai — safalta dimaag se aayegi, aur zindagi ke doosre half mein aayegi. Padhne-likhne, research ya kisi vishesh gyaan ke kshetra mein aapki mehnat compound hokar milegi. Sabra rakhkho, curve exponential hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VI, p.63

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya rekha hriday rekha se uthti hai — jeevan ke baad ke varshon mein sukh aur samriddhi rishton ke raaste aayegi. Prachin niyam ise der se hone wale sukhi vivah aur antim varshon ke aaram ka pakka sanket maanta hai. Aapka best chapter aakhri chapters mein hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VI, p.63

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya rekha par island — ek daur aisa jisme naam ya izzat par sawal uth sakte hain (galatfehmi, controversy, reputation dip). Us window mein transparency hi aapka armour hai: sab kuch record par, sab kuch saaf. Island khatam, chamak wapas.

sources.loc: Ch.VI, Plate XV position 5, pp.65-66 (softened per safety policy)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya rekha par sitara (star) — hatheli ke sabse bhagyashali chinhon mein se ek. Asadharan pehchan, achanak bada avsar ya aisi safalta jiska sapna doosre dekhte hain. Jab yeh phase aaye, bade sapne dekhne se mat darna.

sources.loc: Ch.VI, p.66

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya parvat par bahut si chhoti rekhayein — pratibha ek nahi, kai hain. Lekin yahi problem bhi hai: bahut saare ideas, bikhra hua focus. Niyam yaad rakho — ek saaf Surya rekha sau bikhri rekhaon se behtar hai. Ek chuno, use jitao, phir agla.

sources.loc: Ch.VI, p.65

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Surya rekha par chaukor chinh — aapki position aur naam par hamla hoga toh bhi aap surakshit rahenge. Jalne wale jalte rahenge; square ka matlab hai unki koshishein aap tak pahunch kar bhi tikengi nahi.

sources.loc: Ch.VI, p.66

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Do-teen Surya rekhayein saath-saath samanantar chal rahi hain — do ya teen alag kshetron mein ek saath safalta ka yog. Multi-hyphenate hona aapke liye distraction nahi, design hai.

sources.loc: Ch.VI, p.65

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Cheiro ka angootha-siddhant: angootha teen lokon ka naksha hai — base (Shukra parvat se juda) = PREM, beech ka phalange = TARK (logic), aur nail wala upari hissa = ICCHHA-SHAKTI (will). Jo hissa jitna bada, woh gun jeevan mein utna hi prabal. D'Arpentigny ki baat Cheiro dohrate hain: 'angootha hi insaan ko individual banata hai.'

sources.loc: Part II Ch.II — three worlds of the Thumb: Love (base), Logic (middle), Will (nail phalange)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka angootha supple-jointed hai — peechhe ki taraf mudne wala, lachila. Iska arth: adaptable, broad-minded, unconventional swabhav aur soch-daulat dono mein dariyadili. Safar mein ajnabiyon se dosti aapki speciality hai. Cheiro ka negotiation-secret bhi note kar lo: aap impulse par haan bolte ho par sochne par palat sakte ho — isliye jo aapse kaam nikalwana chahe, woh usi waqt pakka karwa leta hai. Apni is pattern ko jaano, aur bade commitments par 'kal batata hoon' bolna seekho.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.II — supple-jointed thumb (Fig.2, Plate III): adaptable, generous, impulsive yes then reversal on reflection

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka angootha stiff-jointed hai — seedha, kasa hua. Iska arth: soch-samajh kar bolne wala, resist karne wala swabhav. Cheiro ka mirror-insight: aap pehle NA bolte ho aur sochne par HAAN kar sakte ho — bilkul supple walon ka ulta. Aur ek baar faisla ho gaya toh virodh aapko aur pakka kar deta hai. Dosti dheere banti hai par tootti nahi. Train mein ajnabi se baat? Sirf tab jab khidki khuli-band ki behas ho.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.II — firm-jointed thumb (Fig.3): refuses first agrees on reflection, opposition hardens resolve

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Stiff angoothe ke saath lamba nail-phalange — icchha-shakti ka sabse strong combination: jitna lamba yeh upari hissa, utni prachand will force. Jo thaan liya, duniya rok nahi sakti. Bas yeh will sahi cheezon par lage — kyunki galat zid bhi isi taqat se chalti hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.II — firm joint + longer nail phalange = stronger will force

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka angootha hatheli se chipka hua, andar ki taraf khincha rehta hai — parampara mein yeh 'pakad kar rakhne' wale swabhav ka chinh hai: paisa, cheezein, control — chhodna mushkil. Saving aapki superpower hai, par kanjoosi aur security ke beech ki line yaad rakhna — kabhi-kabhi kharch karna bhi investment hota hai, khaaskar rishton mein.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.II — thumb cramped to palm, nail phalange turned in: grasping/retentive nature (miser framing softened)

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapke angoothe ka beech wala joint (Logic phalange) supple hai — Cheiro ka sookshm point: yeh logon ke aage jhukna nahi, PARISTHITIYON ke saath adjust hona dikhata hai. Aap reason se maan lete ho ki halaat ke hisaab se dhalna hi samajhdari hai. Survival skill top-class — bas dhyan raho ki adjust karte-karte apna direction na kho do.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.II — supple middle joint: adapts to circumstances rather than persons

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka angootha clubbed (moongri jaisa mota) type ka hai — parampara mein iska arth: gusse ka fuse bahut chhota, aur jab phat-ta hai toh control mushkil. Yeh jaanna hi aadhi jeet hai. Aapke liye do cheezein non-negotiable hain: (1) trigger ke waqt 10-second pause + kamre se bahar — blind gusse mein KOI faisla, koi message, kuch nahi; (2) regular physical outlet (gym, daud, khel) jo pressure release karta rahe. Fuse chhota hai toh handling careful chahiye — bas itni si baat.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.II — Clubbed thumb (Fig.1, Plate III); 'murderer's thumb' label and crime prediction excluded per safety policy, encoded as temper-management only

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapke angoothe ka beech ka hissa patla — 'waist-like' — hai. Cheiro ke anusaar aise log apni baat argument se nahi, TACT aur diplomacy se manwate hain: sahi waqt, sahi shabd, sahi angle. Aap kamre ka mood padh kar chaal chalte ho — negotiation mein yeh hammer se zyada kaam aata hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.II — waist-like thumb (Fig.4): relies on tact and diplomacy

rules.interpretation_hi_en: Aapka angootha seedha, bharpoor banawat ka hai — waist-like ka ulta: aap tact par nahi, seedhe TARK aur argument par chalte ho. Ghuma-phira kar baat karna aapko aata hi nahi — jo hai, saamne rakh do, reason jeetega. Ijjat isi se milti hai, bas kabhi-kabhi logic ke saath thodi narmi mila lo — sach kadwa ho toh sunna mushkil ho jaata hai.

sources.loc: Part II Ch.II — straight thumb (Fig.5): depends on argument and reason, little tact
